briefings.title: Real Estate Investors on Commercial Market Opportunities

people.name: Torrey Littlejohn
people.role: Senior Managing Director and North Texas Broker Lead, JLL

briefings.tldr: Despite macroeconomic headwinds like higher construction costs, interest rates, and localized office vacancies, Texas commercial real estate leadership remains overwhelmingly optimistic due to strong underlying fundamentals, accelerating corporate relocation velocity, and massive secular demand for digital and residential infrastructure.

briefings.title: Property Play: JLL CEO on how global conflicts and capital shifts are reshaping CRE
briefings.tldr: Despite geopolitical volatility and market fears over AI disruption, JLL is seeing a recovery in commercial real estate driven by a "flight to quality" in core assets and significant productivity gains from decade-long investments in proprietary data and AI tools.
